title: 2022年6月大学英语四级真题（第3套）
paperTitle: 2022年6月大学英语四级真题（第3套）
prompt: 从前, 有个农夫正在地里耕作, 突然看见一只兔子飞奔而过，撞在一棵大树上死了。农夫毫不费力就吃到了兔肉, 心里非常高兴。他想, "如果总是这样该多好啊!" 于是，他不再耕作, 每天守候在那棵树旁，等待着能再捡到撞死在树上的兔子。他等呀等，等了一天又一天, 田地也荒芜了, 却再也没有等到第二只兔子。人们因而都嘲笑他把偶然当成了必然。
reference: Once upon a time, a farmer was working in his field when he suddenly saw a hare dash by and run into a big tree, where it was killed on the spot. As a result, the farmer got a hearty meal of rabbit meat without any effort and was overjoyed. He thought to himself, "How wonderful it would be if this could happen every day!" From then on, he gave up farming and stayed by that tree every day, hoping to pick up another hare that would crash into it and die. But days passed, his fields gradually became overgrown with weeds, yet no second hare ever came. People therefore laughed at him for taking a chance occurrence as an inevitable one.
